elements.contents:
AWESOMEMATH Summer Program

Math Camps / Pre-college students and teachers
The AwesomeMath Summer Program is an intensive three-week online program for gifted students from around the globe. It is designed for bright middle and high school students who wish to sharpen their problem-solving skills and further their mathematics education. Many of our participants seek to improve their performance on contests such as AMC10/12, AIME, or USA(J)MO.

elements.title: The AMR invites submissions for the Paper of the Future Prize
elements.contents:
The AMR invites submissions for the Paper of the Future Prize

Prizes or Awards / Graduate students, Postdocs/early career, Mathematical scientists/faculty
We seek submissions that demonstrate communicative capabilities fundamentally unavailable in a static PDF. Each submission must explicitly articulate what essential communicative function it provides that a linear paper cannot. The initiative is intended as an experiment in format innovation, not as a replacement for traditional scholarship. The prize includes a cash award of $10,000. Submissions are due September 1, 2026.
